items.title: LoveSac By whitearmor
items.detail: LoveSac (LOVE) is a premium furniture retailer operating more than 250 showrooms across the United States, generating approximately $700 million in annual revenue. We have obtained a database containing 1,113,285 order records spanning nearly seven years of transactions, from December 2019 through October 2026, with a combined recorded transaction value exceeding $1.62 billion. Each record contains detailed customer and transaction information, including full customer names, complete billing and shipping addresses, telephone numbers, order numbers, order dates, order statuses, and order grand totals. Our demand: $500,000 in BTC or XMR To verify, samples can be found below. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.

items.title: Glückauf-Vermessung GmbH By payload
items.detail: Glückauf-Vermessung GmbH (glueckauf-vermessung.de) is a German engineering and technical company based in Sondershausen, operating as part of the ERCOSPLAN Group and specializing in surveying and mine surveying (Bergbau-Markscheiderei). Its core business activities include geodetic support for the mining industry, geological exploration, and work related to salt and mineral deposits. The company provides services for surface and underground measurements, deformation monitoring, and the preparation of technical documentation for industrial projects. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.

items.title: Miletic GmbH By payload
items.detail: Miletic GmbH is a German specialized contractor headquartered in Bad Schönborn that has been operating in the construction sector since 1989. The company's core business focuses on construction and repair work for ecologically sensitive industrial facilities, including gas stations, tank farms, and operations governed by German water protection laws (WHG Class LAU facilities). Its service portfolio includes joint sealing and remediation, the application of chemical-resistant protective coatings, concrete construction, and related earthworks. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
